Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document shows the protective maintenance which must be 
 performed monthly on the thrust bearing oil circulation pump as 
 indicated by M1 
 in the title block.
This pump function is to pumped the oil through the oil 
 cooling system the technical specification of the oil pump :
capacity Q | : | 300 
 L/m
pressure p | : | 5.2 
 bar
speed N |  | 3000 
 rpm
power | : | 7.5 kw
This document is initiated and tested by eng. 
 Ahmed Abdel Qader Mahmoud, revised by 
 eng. Abdel Gwad Yosef Mohamed, accepted by eng. Ebrahim Abdel Rahman Ahmad 
 general manager, and approved by eng. Khalaf Allah Mahmoud Abd El 
 gaber head sector of Aswan Hydraulic power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Osama Solima 
 HPGC general director quality control .
Safety 
Precaution
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the safety and healthy 
 protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet .... etc
Maintenance staff should be well 
 trained & qualified or directly
Supervised by some one
Switch off pump
Tools 
and Equipment
Set wrenches and screw drivers
Kerosene and cleaning material 
 (rag. cloth)
Work to be 
carried out
Hear the pump in operation
Revision normal operation of the bearings, vibrations, and leakage
Through the sealing joints
Check up the fastening of the pump
Check up the coupling and change it if necessary
Make the necessary cleaning
